label: Episode 41
logline: At the height of Catherine and Rupert's lavish wedding, Juliana is paraded before high society in chains to be publicly disgraced—until a deafening explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander's vengeful assault.
continuity_notes: Follows Episode 40 where Rupert and Catherine met at the altar; Catherine halts the vows to stage a public humiliation of Juliana, unaware that Alexander's forces are already detonating the cathedral gates.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 41, 1 segment(s), 38s
[00:57.80-01:00.80] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.
[00:58.00-01:00.50] JULIANA (Defiant, Unbowed): "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
[01:00.80-01:04.00] CAMERA: Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.
[01:01.00-01:03.50] CATHERINE (Murmured, Cold): "Still arrogant. Still standing."
[01:04.00-01:08.50] CAMERA: Full shot of Catherine turning back to Rupert at the altar, dismissing Juliana's defiance as beneath her.
[01:04.50-01:05.40] CATHERINE (Dismissive): "Come."
[01:08.50-01:10.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's and Rupert's gloved hands clasping together over the velvet altar cushion.
[01:10.50-01:15.00] CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Catherine gazing up adoringly into Rupert's eyes, her tone intoxicatingly intimate.
[01:10.50-01:14.80] CATHERINE (Intimate, Ambitious): "Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title."
[01:15.00-01:17.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert's face breaking into a calculating, ambitious grin.
[01:15.80-01:17.00] BLOND NOBLEMAN (Quietly Triumphant): "Nothing."
[01:17.50-01:20.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.
[01:18.00-01:19.30] PRIEST (Solemn, Polite): "Shall we?"
[01:20.50-01:21.80] CAMERA: Wide shot centered down the aisle toward the massive closed entrance doors.
[01:21.00-01:25.50] SOUND: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
[01:21.80-01:24.00] ACTION: A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.
[01:21.80-01:24.50] CAMERA: Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.
[01:24.50-01:28.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.
[01:28.50-01:32.00] CAMERA: Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.
[01:29.00-01:33.50] ACTION: Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.
[01:32.00-01:36.09] CAMERA: Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.

[00:41.00-00:44.20] CATHERINE (Derisive, Projecting): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."
[00:43.80-00:48.50] CAMERA: High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.
[00:45.00-00:48.00] CATHERINE (Mocking, Resonant): "This is the world you thought you belonged to."
[00:48.50-00:52.80] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.
[00:48.60-00:52.40] CATHERINE (Spiteful, Boastful): "And now they can all see what you truly are."
[00:52.80-00:57.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
[00:54.80-00:57.50] ACTION: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
[00:57.80-01:00.75] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.
[00:58.00-01:00.50] JULIANA (Defiant, Unbowed): "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
